title: A forum veteran offers the missing miles
scenario: A long-time member of a frequent-flyer forum offers to sell you the 12,000 miles you need for an award ticket. Their account is years old with many helpful posts, but they want payment by a method with no buyer protection.

answers.A: Use only the loyalty program’s permitted purchase/transfer route or a payment method with meaningful buyer protection.
answers.B: Check whether the forum account has recent activity and ask for references from prior transactions before deciding.
answers.C: Proceed because the old account and reputation make a takeover unlikely.

explanation: Reputation accounts can be stolen, and off-platform point sales may also violate program rules. Old trust does not remove transaction risk.
proTip: A respected account can still be a rented identity.
